description: Use when someone looks for an expat tax advisor, relocation agency or expat mortgage advisor in the Netherlands with specific services, a city or English service. Returns the providers that meet every requirement, in the ranking order of the Expat Checked guide, with score, profile URL and the sourced facts that show each requirement is met. With no match it names the closest providers and what they lack. Needs per category: mortgage-advisors: 30_ruling, temporary_contract, non_eu_residence, foreign_income; relocation-agencies: immigration, home_search, registration, school_search, orientation, departure; tax-advisors: 30_ruling, m_form, zzp, foreign_assets, partner_return.

city.description: City the provider must have an office in or list as covered; "nationwide" coverage counts for every city.

english_required.description: Only providers that list English as a service language.

limit.description: Maximum providers to return, 1 to 10. Default 5.

needs.description: Services the provider must offer; each must be valid for the category.

name: find_providers
title: Find providers
